title: The Ext connecting map is composition with the extension class
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, with Ext as in [def-sc-ext-sheaf] and Yoneda composition as in [lem-sc-p1-ext-yoneda-functoriality]. Let $0\to\mathcal A\to\mathcal B\to\mathcal C\to0$ be a short exact sequence of $\mathcal O_X$-modules with Yoneda class $\delta\in\operatorname{Ext}^1_X(\mathcal C,\mathcal A)$, and let $\mathcal F$ be an $\mathcal O_X$-module. Then the connecting map $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal F,\mathcal C)\to\operatorname{Ext}^1_X(\mathcal F,\mathcal A)$ of the long exact sequence of [def-sc-ext-sheaf] for this short exact sequence sends $s$ to $\delta\circ s$.
